def factor_volume_gated_leverage_corr(df):
    """Volume-gated leverage effect: rolling correlation between return and range volatility, amplified in high-volume regimes and dampened in low-volume regimes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    range_vol = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / prev_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=30).corr(range_vol)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(
        df_copy["volume"], window=20
    )
    weight = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 1.3, 1.0)
    weight = np.where(is_low_vol > 0, 0.7, weight)
    factor = -corr * weight
    factor.name = "factor_volume_gated_leverage_corr"
    return factor
description: Preserves the parent leverage-effect mechanism: negative rolling correlation between daily return and normalized high-low range captures asymmetric volatility where down moves coincide with larger ranges. The targeted mutation adds a volume-regime attenuation using alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime as a bounded weight (1.3 in high-volume, 0.7 in low-volume, 1.0 otherwise), emphasizing liquidity-driven price impact and damping illiquid noise. This keeps one core mechanism and one modifier, and the continuous raw signal remains suitable for cross-sectional binning.
